notes.title: BOO!! Cyber Soldier is here! Halloween release on Steam.
notes.content:
Hello guys!,

The day has come when Cyber Soldier finally saw the light of day, [i]and it so happened[/i].. that it saw the light not of a day but of a full mo[i]o[/i]n, with gloomy m[u]ist[/u] all around, the dead [strike]air[/strike], and un[i]dead[/i] creatures wandering everywhere from the beyond... Evil laughter echoes through the oppressive atmosphere, as ev[u]i[/u]l celebrates its [strike]freedom.[/strike]

And this is your time, Cyber, gear up with powerful weapons and start destroying everything around!
[u][b]Open fire on all threats immediately.[/b][/u]

[i]After all, someone has to cleanse all the evil, right?[/i]
